fee_notes: Single-territory Initial Franchise Fee is $59,500 (covers ~50,000 owner-occupied homes). Multi-territory cumulative fees are: 2 territories = $99,500, 3 = $134,500, 4 = $164,500, 5 = $194,500. An overage fee of $1.19 per excess owner-occupied home applies if the territory exceeds the standard home count. Existing franchisees of current or future affiliates may receive a discretionary discount. Fee is non-refundable and deemed fully earned upon execution. Additional one-time fees also due at or after signing: Brand Marketing Fee of $15,500 (one per franchisee regardless of territories), Tuition Fee of $4,995, and ZeePartnerships Fee of $5,000.
raw_excerpt:
Initial Franchise Fee.  You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $59,500 (the "Initial Franchise Fee") when you sign the Franchise Agreement, which includes a Protected Territory of approximately 50,000 owner-occupied homes.

You may purchase additional units each with a stand-alone Protected Territory containing approximately 50,000 owner-occupied homes. The amount of the Initial Franchise Fee will depend on the number of Protected Territories you purchase and is calculated as follows:

Number of Territories Cumulative Initial Franchise Fees Individual Franchise Fee Cumulative Number Owner-Occupied Homes
#1 $59,500 $59,500 50,000
#2 $99,500 $40,000 100,000
#3 $134,500 $35,000 150,000
#4 $164,500 $30,000 200,000
#5 $194,500 $30,000 250,000
